karma:read-the-answer.corrected_answer:
Yes in form, in part. What the map shares with karma read as conditioned arising: one relation of condition; what is done changes the conditions of what follows, and some of it persists; a thing is a line under a class. The account starts there, and the atlas reads the texts so, each in part. Proved, under premises: the grammar admits an occurrence with no condition, so that all arises from conditions is a premise; acts return only where the loop closes, with no sign; a present a list holds forgets. These do not refute karma as just return, the atlas says, nor give it.

Where it parts. In the texts ignorance is not knowing stated things, and knowing ends it. The atlas marks our use of the word a divergence, and our one test found being told was not enough. Some texts argue against continuation itself: the Middle Treatise refutes the line we build on, and release is the line ending. Shared karma, late ripening and turning back are my likenesses; the repository holds none. That what a thing rests on and what makes a difference to it come apart is understood, proved in pieces. No theorem evaluates.

declarations.name: Becoming.PositionTerms.keeps_at_of_terms
declarations.lean_statement:
theorem keeps_at_of_terms [DecidableEq α] {ps : List α} {w w' : α → Nat} {p : α} (mem : p ∈ ps)
    (concordant : concord ps w (oneAt p) = concord ps w' (oneAt p))
    (discordant : discord ps w (oneAt p) = discord ps w' (oneAt p)) :
    riseCount ps w w' p = fallCount ps w w' p
declarations.told_in_words: Member by member, with decidable equality. declarations.name: Becoming.PositionTerms.keeps_of_own_concord
declarations.lean_statement:
theorem keeps_of_own_concord {ps : List α} {w w' : α → Nat}
    (first : SelectionTerm.concord ps w w = SelectionTerm.concord ps w' w)
    (second : SelectionTerm.concord ps w w' = SelectionTerm.concord ps w' w') :
    RelativePosition.Keeps ps w w'
declarations.told_in_words: Premises: w has the same concordance with w as w' has with w, and w has the same concordance with w' as w' has with w'. Then the profiles give every listed member the same position. No decidable equality, no discordance, two amounts. Rests on pairs_agree (in the module: the squared differences of the two excess readings total nothing, by SelectionTerm.pair_balance at each pair), then RelativePosition.keeps_iff_common.

declarations.name: Becoming.PositionTerms.keeps_iff_own_concord
declarations.lean_statement:
theorem keeps_iff_own_concord {ps : List α} {w w' : α → Nat} :
    RelativePosition.Keeps ps w w' ↔
      SelectionTerm.concord ps w w = SelectionTerm.concord ps w' w ∧
        SelectionTerm.concord ps w w' = SelectionTerm.concord ps w' w'
declarations.told_in_words: Two profiles give every listed member the same position exactly where each has the same concordance with w as the other, and the same with w'. No premise.

declarations.lean_statement:
theorem keeps_of_shifted {ps : List α} {w w' : α → Nat} {k : Nat}
    (shift : ∀ p, p ∈ ps → w' p = w p + k) : RelativePosition.Keeps ps w w'
declarations.told_in_words: A profile shifted at every listed member by a common k gives every listed member the same position: RelativePosition.keeps_add (RelativePosition.lean:306) carried to any profile that agrees with fun p => w p + k on the list. declarations.name: Becoming.PositionTerms.kept_step
declarations.lean_statement:
theorem kept_step {G G' : SelectionTerm.Generations α} {t : Nat}
    (family : G'.family t = G.family t)
    (amount : ∀ p, p ∈ G.family t → G'.amount t p = G.amount t p)
    (keeps : RelativePosition.Keeps (G.family t) (G.offspringNumber t) (G'.offspringNumber t)) :
    G'.concordAt t = G.concordAt t ∧ G'.discordAt t = G.discordAt t
declarations.told_in_words: On a step of two courses of generations: the same family at t, amounts alike on it, and offspring numbers that give every member of the family the same position give the same concordance and discordance at t. declarations.lean_statement:
theorem shift_step_terms_as_case {G G' : SelectionTerm.Generations α} {t k : Nat}
    (family : G'.family t = G.family t)
    (amount : ∀ p, p ∈ G.family t → G'.amount t p = G.amount t p)
    (shift : ∀ p, p ∈ G.family t → G'.offspringNumber t p = G.offspringNumber t p + k) :

declarations.name: Becoming.PositionTerms.keeps_order
declarations.lean_statement:

    {p q : α} (mp : p ∈ ps) (mq : q ∈ ps) : w q < w p ↔ w' q < w' p
declarations.told_in_words: Profiles with the same positions keep which of two listed members has more. Rests on keeps_iff_common and SelectionTerm.lt_iff_of_balance (SelectionTerm.lean:115).

declarations.name: Becoming.PositionTerms.TwoProfiles.same_order_apart
declarations.lean_statement:
theorem same_order_apart :
    (∀ p q : Bool, near q < near p ↔ far q < far p) ∧
      ¬ RelativePosition.Keeps [false, true] near far
declarations.told_in_words: A kept witness on two members (near is nothing and one, far is nothing and two): the same member has more under both profiles, and the profiles do not give the members the same positions. So Keeps is not sameness of order.

declarations.name: Becoming.PositionTerms.TwoProfiles.one_amount_not_enough
declarations.lean_statement:
theorem one_amount_not_enough :
    (concord [false, true] near (fun _ => 0) = concord [false, true] far (fun _ => 0) ∧
        discord [false, true] near (fun _ => 0) = discord [false, true] far (fun _ => 0)) ∧
      ¬ RelativePosition.Keeps [false, true] near far
